1.description_excerpt: Bitcoin (BTC) is a decentralized digital currency that enables peer-to-peer transactions without intermediaries, using blockchain technology to ensure security and transparency. It was created in 2009 by an anonymous entity known as Satoshi Nakamoto.
1.name: Bitcoin

1027.description_excerpt: Ethereum (ETH) is a decentralized platform that enables developers to build and deploy smart contracts and decentralized applications (dApps) using blockchain technology. It facilitates peer-to-peer transactions and applications without a central authority.
1027.name: Ethereum

10529.description_excerpt: SUN is a cryptocurrency that serves as the native token for the TRON blockchain ecosystem, primarily aimed at incentivizing content creators and enhancing the decentralized finance (DeFi) space. It allows users to engage in various activities such as staking, participating in governance, and accessing DeFi services.
10529.name: Sun [New]

11092.description_excerpt: Bitget Token (BGB) is the native utility token of the Bitget exchange, used for fee discounts, trading rewards, and participating in token sales. It aims to enhance user experience and engagement on the platform.
11092.name: Bitget Token

11419.description_excerpt: Toncoin (TON) is the native cryptocurrency of the Telegram Open Network, designed to facilitate fast and secure transactions within the Telegram ecosystem. It aims to support a broad range of decentralized applications and services.
11419.name: Gram (prev. Toncoin)

11840.description_excerpt: Optimism (OP) is a Layer 2 scaling solution for Ethereum that enhances transaction speed and reduces costs by utilizing Optimistic Rollups. It aims to provide a seamless experience for decentralized applications while maintaining Ethereum's security.
11840.name: Optimism

11841.description_excerpt: Arbitrum (ARB) is a layer-2 scaling solution for Ethereum that enhances transaction speed and reduces costs by utilizing optimistic rollups. It enables decentralized applications to operate more efficiently on the Ethereum network.
11841.name: Arbitrum

131.description_excerpt: Dash (DASH) is a digital currency that enables fast, low-cost transactions and enhanced privacy features through its unique two-tier network. It aims to provide a user-friendly experience for everyday transactions.
131.name: Dash

1321.description_excerpt: Ethereum Classic (ETC) is a decentralized blockchain platform that enables smart contracts and decentralized applications, originating from a split of the original Ethereum network in 2016. It maintains the original Ethereum blockchain's principles, promoting immutability and resistance to censorship.
1321.name: Ethereum Classic

13502.description_excerpt: Worldcoin (WLD) is a cryptocurrency designed to create a globally inclusive financial network by distributing digital currency to individuals through a unique biometric identification system. It aims to promote economic equity and secure identities in the digital economy.
13502.name: Worldcoin

1437.description_excerpt: Zcash (ZEC) is a cryptocurrency that offers enhanced privacy features through zero-knowledge proofs, allowing users to make transactions without revealing their identities. It aims to provide secure and anonymous digital transactions while maintaining the transparency of the blockchain.
1437.name: Zcash

16086.description_excerpt: BitTorrent (BTT) is a cryptocurrency used to enhance the BitTorrent protocol by enabling faster and more efficient peer-to-peer file sharing through blockchain technology. It incentivizes file sharing and distribution, rewarding users for their contributions to the network.
16086.name: BitTorrent [New]

1659.description_excerpt: Gnosis (GNO) is a decentralized platform that enables users to create and manage prediction markets and decentralized applications, utilizing blockchain technology for secure and transparent transactions. Its native token, GNO, is used for governance and incentivizing participation in the Gnosis ecosystem.
1659.name: Gnosis

1831.description_excerpt: Bitcoin Cash (BCH) is a cryptocurrency that was created as a fork of Bitcoin in 2017, aiming to enable faster and cheaper transactions by increasing block size limits. It seeks to provide a more practical digital cash solution for everyday transactions.
1831.name: Bitcoin Cash

1839.description_excerpt: BNB is the native cryptocurrency of the Binance exchange, used for trading fee discounts and various decentralized applications within the Binance ecosystem. Additionally, it plays a key role in the Binance Smart Chain, supporting smart contracts and decentralized finance (DeFi) applications.
1839.name: BNB

1958.description_excerpt: TRON (TRX) is a decentralized platform designed to build and deploy decentralized applications (dApps) and smart contracts on its blockchain. It aims to revolutionize the digital content ecosystem by enabling direct sharing and distribution without intermediaries.
1958.name: TRON

1975.description_excerpt: Chainlink (LINK) is a decentralized oracle network that enables smart contracts to securely interact with real-world data and off-chain resources. It aims to bridge the gap between blockchain technology and external data sources for enhanced functionality.
1975.name: Chainlink

2.description_excerpt: Litecoin (LTC) is a peer-to-peer cryptocurrency designed for fast and low-cost transactions, often referred to as the "silver to Bitcoin's gold." It was created in 2011 by Charlie Lee to improve upon Bitcoin's technology with faster block generation times.
2.name: Litecoin

2010.description_excerpt: Cardano (ADA) is a decentralized platform that enables the development and execution of smart contracts and decentralized applications with a focus on scalability, sustainability, and interoperability. It utilizes a unique proof-of-stake consensus mechanism called Ouroboros to enhance energy efficiency.
2010.name: Cardano

2011.description_excerpt: Tezos (XTZ) is a decentralized blockchain platform that enables smart contracts and decentralized applications while allowing users to participate in its governance through a formal voting process. Its self-amending protocol facilitates upgrades without the need for hard forks.
2011.name: Tezos

20396.description_excerpt: Kaspa (KAS) is a high-performance blockchain that utilizes a blockDAG architecture, enabling fast and secure transactions with a unique consensus mechanism. Its design aims to provide scalability and efficiency for decentralized applications.
20396.name: Kaspa

2087.description_excerpt: KuCoin Token (KCS) is the native cryptocurrency of the KuCoin exchange, enabling users to receive trading fee discounts, participate in token sales, and earn rewards. Holding KCS also allows users to benefit from the exchange's profit-sharing model.
2087.name: KuCoin Token

20947.description_excerpt: Sui (SUI) is a scalable Layer 1 blockchain designed for secure and fast transactions, facilitating new decentralized applications and opportunities in the Web3 ecosystem. Its innovative architecture aims to optimize both performance and user experience.

21159.description_excerpt: Ondo (ONDO) is a decentralized finance protocol designed to optimize yield generation through innovative staking and liquidity solutions. It aims to empower users with greater control and flexibility over their assets.

21794.description_excerpt: Aptos (APT) is a Layer 1 blockchain designed for high scalability and safety, utilizing a novel programming language and parallel execution to enhance transaction speed and efficiency. It aims to deliver a user-friendly environment for developers and end-users alike.

22691.description_excerpt: Starknet (STRK) is a decentralized, scalable Layer 2 solution for Ethereum that utilizes zero-knowledge rollups to enhance transaction speed and reduce costs. It aims to provide a secure and efficient environment for building decentralized applications.

2280.description_excerpt: Filecoin (FIL) is a decentralized storage network that enables users to rent out their unused hard drive space in exchange for Filecoin tokens. It incentivizes file storage and retrieval on the blockchain, ensuring data can be stored reliably and efficiently.

22861.description_excerpt: Celestia (TIA) is a modular blockchain network designed to separate the consensus and data availability layers, enabling developers to create customized blockchains without the complexities of building their own infrastructure. It aims to improve scalability and flexibility for decentralized applications.

24478.name: Pepe

7226.description_excerpt: Injective is an interoperable Layer 1 blockchain designed for DeFi applications. It provides developers with on-chain financial infrastructure modules to build dApps such as decentralized exchanges, prediction markets, and lending protocols.
